verdict.rationale: Alma is a technology-enabled immigration law firm with a client portal, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence describes an AI assistant users can delegate tasks to. The portal questionnaires, attorney-led cases, and 'case intelligence' are adjacent features, not a user-facing AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
